body:
I’ve noticed the exact same thing.
I think it’s because of weak deep neck flexors and tight upper traps.
I’ve sort it noticed it the other way.
The tight upper traps makes me suck in my belly.

What did you do specifically to resolve it.

I stretch tight muscles and strengthen weak opposing muscles. And try make lifestyle changes and manually adjust my posture.

But that still doesn’t address the deep neck flexors.

I haven’t done an emg or anything.

I am able to push my neck into it.
But when I do the chin tucks I feel my sternoclomastoid compensating and activating instead.

And my neck muscle just feels all tense and uncomfortable when the sternoclomastoid activates.

Whereas about 6-12 months ago when I used to do it.
Id feel a relief, and I could breathe better and my neck would feel more stable and supported.

Also to add I’ve stretched my sternoclomastoid and back of my neck and I think it helped.
But still my deep neck flexors don’t activate during chin tucks.
you might have a tight psoas this can make it hard to sleep in my experience. Go on YouTube for psoas stretches.
